note: Success criterion 3's cheapest conformance vector: construct an aggregation whose window contained no readings and verify the consumer does not treat it as an observation. sample_count has shipped since v1.0.0 as the missing-data flag with nothing required to read it; tracker#63 supplied the obligation and this suite is how it is checked at the boundary the data actually crosses.

vectors.note: window contained zero readings; every statistic is undefined

expect.reason: an aggregation entry MUST omit every statistic its window does not define

vectors.note: one reading defines the location statistics and not the spread

expect.reason: variance is undefined below two readings

vectors.note: a silent host and a calm host must not be indistinguishable

expect.reason: an aggregator MUST emit an entry for a host whose window was empty rather than dropping it

vectors.note: the vector the ticket asked for, stated from the reading side

expect.reason: a consumer MUST NOT treat an entry as an observation unless sample_count is greater than zero, and MUST NOT substitute a value for an omitted statistic

vectors.note: a v1.0.0 aggregator that emits a mean over nothing beside sample_count 0

expect.reason: sample_count governs. A value present alongside sample_count 0 is non-conformant output and MUST NOT be read as an observation; this is why omission was ruled over flagging.

vectors.note: sample_count is REQUIRED; an entry without it is undefined, not empty

expect.reason: an undefined input MUST NOT resolve toward permission (KTP-CORE Section 5.9); an absent count and a zero count do not separate
